items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I took Delia(?) on the road with me for a while... And I finally sent them to Ohio and let them stay... They didn't need to be out there on the road with me

ctx.x: It's like I don't go on the road with the guys. I make the records, but by this time I've reached another standard.
Right, right. So I went on the road. I left my wife. She was pregnant with my daughter then. I took Delia(?) on the road with me for a while...
Delia was telling me about that the other night.
